CHAPTER 4 · ITEM 06 / 10

Equilibrium and changing markets

Solving equilibrium求均衡

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Find equilibrium in a graph, schedule or equations by setting Qd = Qs and solving for price and quantity.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

均衡要求同一價格下 Qd=Qs。聯立求 P，再代回兩式檢查數量一致。

Equilibrium equates quantity demanded and supplied at one price. Solve the equations together, then substitute the price back into either equation and check both give the same quantity.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Qs=2P and Qd=300−P. 2P=300−P gives P=100 and Q=200. 兩式皆得到 200。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Qs=P, Qd=60−2P. Equilibrium P and Q? 均衡？
